answer: Each agent must bond timber harvested from a registered plot, verified by a unique provenance hash tied to a river basin and a willow grove boundary. Sybil resistance can work through stake-weighted identity anchored to a scarce physical credential. Duplicate identities cannot reuse the same plot hash, so manufacturing fake agents requires acquiring and bonding real, non-fungible resources at market cost. An attacker scaling to N sybils must pay N times the timber bond plus verification fees, making mass forgery economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0198's threat model.
